about.description: Upon entering Kitty's Kafe, locals and visitors alike are greeted by a warm, friendly, casual family atmosphere. Whether joining for a Southern Style Country Breakfast, enjoying one of many delicious lunch items, or scrumptious entrees, food is prepared daily from the freshest ingredients. Full service bar available.
about.elevator_pitch: A casual family-style Southern restaurant serving home-cooked meals with genuine hospitality.
